These queries are untested: I could not run anything, and each is written from the documentation page alone.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(if (/active) ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") ~(false)) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles * lower | contains "admin") | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (/labels * (/name | lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | if (eq null) ~(null) ~(/login))}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * ([(/0 | keyword) "@" /1] | join "")
T9: /services | filter ~(if (at :enabled | coalesce false) ~(/port | gt 8000) ~(false)) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | at 2) * count
T11: lines * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | flat * (drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * split "," | filter ~(if (/5 | lower | eq "shipped") ~(/4 | ne "") ~(false)) * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * split "," | filter ~(if (/5 | lower | eq "cancelled") ~(false) ~(/4 | ne "")) | groupBy ~(/1) * (/ * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana" "apple" "Cherry" "banana" "fig" "APPLE" "date" "kiwi" "Fig" "elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
